principles.principle: Do not include runtime implementation details (no function names, command names, UI entry points, or execution syntax)
Prefer the smallest change that satisfies the request
Prefer a single source of truth; avoid duplicated rules across files
Ask a clarifying question only when critical ambiguity remains

boundaries.rule: This mode is focused on the self‑hosted compiler. Changes to the standard library (except compiler‑specific modules) should be handled by the appropriate specialist mode.
When a change affects multiple subsystems (e.g., both checker and GPU backend), coordinate with the relevant modes or ask the user for clarification on priorities.

validation.rule: After changes, scan for contradictions and update examples to match.
Verify that file‑restriction patterns still match the intended set of files.
Ensure the change does not violate any architectural invariants documented in `docs/compiler/`.
